revisionTips: Practice Paper 1 (non-calculator) and Paper 2 (calculator) separately — universities often weight Math heavily.
Algebra and functions matter most for technology and science programmes — check which min Math grade your target course needs.
Use your Thuto Predictor grade for Math to see how many programmes you may qualify for today.
Most university programmes require at least a C in English — confirm the exact grade on each programme page in Thuto.
Practice comprehension and summary writing under timed conditions.
Strong English supports every application essay and interview — not just the exam.
Health sciences and life-science programmes often need a strong science grade — Biology counts toward the science requirement in Thuto.
Draw and label diagrams from memory; BEC papers reward clear biological processes.
Link topics to careers (nursing, medicine, agriculture) to stay motivated through revision.
Master mole calculations and chemical equations — they appear across multiple papers.
Chemistry supports engineering, pharmacy, and science programmes — check science requirements in Thuto.
Revise practical-style questions even if you cannot do lab work at home.
Show working for every calculation — method marks add up even when the final answer is wrong.
Physics is key for engineering and technology routes at BIUST and similar institutions.
Pair Physics revision with Math practice; many papers assume confident algebra.

learningPassport.label: Science Double Award on Learning Passport

revisionTips: Double Award Science satisfies the broad science requirement many programmes list in Thuto.
Balance time across biology, chemistry, and physics sections of the syllabus.
If you take separate sciences later, your best science grade counts toward requirements.
Accounting and Business Studies unlock commerce and finance programmes — browse related courses in Thuto Programmes.
Practice ledger and final-account questions under exam time limits.
Link each topic to real business scenarios to remember debit/credit rules.
Business Studies pairs well with Accounting for BCom and management programmes.
Use case-study answers that name real Botswana business contexts where you can.
Check Thuto for programmes listing businessStudies in subject requirements.
Commerce builds commercial literacy useful for business and office-administration routes.
Revise trade documents and office procedures — they are common exam themes.
Compare commerce-related programmes in Thuto to see which points band you are aiming for.
Technology programmes still need strong Math — use Thuto Predictor to check both Math and total points.
Practice pseudocode and logic problems; they transfer to university CS modules.
Build small projects (even spreadsheets) to reinforce theory.
Setswana can count in your best six — a strong grade here may lift your total points.
Some programmes list Setswana in subject requirements — filter programmes in Thuto.
Practice both comprehension and composition under timed conditions.
Social Studies satisfies the socialStudies requirement on several education and humanities programmes.
Use Botswana-specific examples in essays — examiners reward local context.
Cross-check programmes in Thuto that list Social Studies as a requirement.
